# iboss_security_groups (Data Source)

Lists every security (filtering) group in the account, sorted by group number. Useful for exporting per-group policy, such as block lists, to files.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iboss_security_groups" "all" {}

# Map of "<number>. <name>" labels, as shown in the iboss console.
output "security_group_labels" {
  value = [for g in data.iboss_security_groups.all.groups : "${g.group_number}. ${g.name}"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `groups` (Attributes List) Security groups, sorted by `group_number`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The account settings ID the groups belong to.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `group_number` (Number) Group number (`groupNumber`).
- `name` (String) Group name (`groupName`).
- `note` (String) Group note (`note`).
- `parent_group_number` (Number) Parent group number (`parentGroupNumber`).
- `priority` (Number) Group priority (`priority`).
- `reporting_group_number` (Number) Reporting group number (`reportingGroupNumber`).
- `reserved` (Boolean) Whether the group is reserved (`reservedGroup`).
